description: Machine-readable, append-only signal track record. Includes a by_signal_type breakdown: for each signal (ENTER, EXIT_NOW, STEALTH_ACCUM, DISTRIBUTION_TRAP, TAKE_PROFIT…) the sample size and average 1h/6h/24h return plus directional accuracy, and calibration_slices (e.g. high-confidence-only, confirmed-only). Lets an agent decide how much to trust each signal type. Paper outcomes, |return|>500% excluded as glitch — descriptive, not a profit promise.
name: track_record
